verdict.rationale: Qodo's own docs say reviews can be triggered manually or automatically and that users can control when reviews run on a pull request. Repository-level config via the portal or .pr_agent.toml gives a place for such settings. The evidence is a single summary line, though, and none of the specific filters the story names are documented. Missing for 10: documented draft-PR skipping, branch-based filtering, label-based filtering, detail on the manual trigger mechanism (e.g., a comment command), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I control when reviews run — skip drafts, trigger on demand, filter by branch or label — so the bot shows up only when wanted

citations.quote: Trigger a Qodo code review manually or automatically, and control when reviews run on a pull request.
Manage Qodo configuration as code using a .pr\_agent.toml file at the repository, project, group, or organization level.
Repository level: Settings apply only to the selected repository and override the organization-level defaults
